about: Known vulnerabilities in production dependencies accepted for now: each says why it can't hurt here, and until when (scripts/audit-deps.mjs fails again after that date).

accepted.reason: Zod 3 checks every item of a huge list. Shap Pocket's engine runs on the phone and only its own screens call it; every call goes through parse() (packages/engine/src/lib/validate.ts), which refuses oversized lists before Zod sees them. Fixed by moving to Zod 4.6.6+, planned.
